snippet.title: Lizard Simulator — Official Teaser
snippet.description:
You're a lizard. The town is not ready.
Lizard Simulator is a physics-driven chaos sandbox. Tongue-grab, wall-climb, and ragdoll your way through a town full of panicking NPCs and destructible everything.
Early Access — May 8, 2026
Search "Lizard Simulator" on Steam to wishlist!
Follow us:
Instagram: @lizardsimulator
TikTok: @lizardsimulator
